decisions.reason: Although adjacent to our fluid-handling know-how, the minimum quantity lubrication system is the least central to our filtration and recycling core, and its lack of continued website presence after launch suggests limited traction that does not justify further development effort.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on our core filtration expertise, so our in-house R&D, modular platforms and existing customer relationships give us strong capacity to improve and commercialize it further.

The gravity band coolant filter is very close to our established coolant filtration offer and strengthens our one-stop systems portfolio, making it well suited to continued refinement through our existing engineering and service capabilities.
